Scoped fresh-context adjudication of the R5.23 ≤950 trigger (worker checkpoint `afe03466` on `codex/harnessharness-evidence-r5.23`, base `d5f6810a`).

## Verdict: AMEND

- **Measured:** 1,527 changed source/test lines (numstat `d5f6810a..afe03466 -- crates/`: receipt.rs +1,065, tests/r5_23.rs +456, lib.rs +6) vs ≤950 (~1.6×). r5_23 battery 9/9 green at checkpoint.
- **One owner interface:** `assemble_receipt` is a single in-process owner interface — `population-receipt/1` is the legs'+verdicts' own fold (one `legs[]`/`failures[]` accumulation; `to_json` serializes the whole). Decomposition owner-seam row 31 assigns "R5.23 assembly" whole (boundaries at the R5.21 data-owner / R5.22 traversal / R5.24–27 consumer tickets); partition R3 is one scope sentence with no contingency clause (contrast X7/M-A).
- **The L150 "population contract vs consumer wiring" seam is consumed; R5.23 sits on its consumer side:** contract landed hh-eval `population.rs` (R5.15/seq 184); consumer wiring was the hh-analysis `planned_population` adapter (seq 184a). R5.23 calls that adapter; a re-cut would either duplicate the contract (C.8) or force a contract crate to name producer view types — the joins need ExperimentView (hh-experiment), EvalRun/GradeSelection (hh-eval), ResultsRow (hh-results), and only hh-analysis already holds all three edges; hh-bundle cannot (C.1 item 6 / C.8 / C.10 — reverse edge rejected, "producers pass records in").
- **AC-1 binds the axes to the chain members conjunctively:** the six-hop set-equality chain AND the separate prerequisite/process/task/veto verdicts are one predicate. The proposed weakest cut (legs 1–5 + declared records / leg 6 + verdicts + codec + battery) splits mid-predicate — leg (a) cannot close AC-1 without the rows→analysis hop or the axes (a legs-1–5 `closed` verdict is the favorable-shrink AC-2/C.9-check-2 forbids); leg (b) has no chain to join. Non-curative: leg (a) alone remains over trigger — a split buys an over-trigger leg by fragmenting one admitted unit (R5.18–R5.22 pattern).
- **Magnitude in band:** ~1.6× inside the accepted envelope (≤2.6× R5.8; ~1.85–2.4× routinely amended) — at the low end, equal to the pre-ruled split-leg band (R5.15b ~1.6×, R5.16b ~1.46×).
